workIntro: A selection of projects across the web, mobile applications and software infrastructure. Explore the experience, then the code behind it.
p1Desc: A multilingual guide to the IPB canteen: browse dishes with photographs, plan meals and estimate a budget. A practical tool built around everyday student life.
p2Desc: A banking application connecting an Angular interface to a Fastify gateway and Kotlin/Spring microservices, with RabbitMQ messaging and PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases.
p3Desc: An expense-sharing application built with React Native, Expo and TypeScript, using Supabase. A mobile approach to organising shared expenses.
p4Desc: A website for the DIEGÉTIKA theatre group and a companion editorial tool for preparing news, productions and galleries. The editor previews content and exports update packages.
p5Desc: An equipment maintenance application combining an Angular front end with a Java and Spring back end. Software analysis translated into a connected web system.
p6Desc: A Bash backup tool using rsync and cron, with logging and configurable routines. Bringing repeatability and traceability to system administration tasks.
projectNote: Personal and academic work. Repository documentation provides context and team credits.

aboutBody: I’m Pedro Eduardo Dall’Agnol, a Brazilian developer based in Bragança, Portugal. I study Systems Analysis and Development at UFPR and am undertaking academic mobility in Computer Engineering at IPB in 2026–2027.
aboutBody2: My work connects front-end and back-end development, software analysis, database modelling and network administration. I enjoy turning complex problems into clear, usable solutions.
aboutBody3: Yggdrasil, the tree of life in Norse mythology, inspires this portfolio: different branches, shared foundations. A personal way to represent how design, code and infrastructure connect.
based: Based in Portugal. Connected to the world.

s2Body: Application logic, object-oriented programming and software integration.
s3Body: Data modelling, queries and database administration.
s4Body: Network simulation and analysis, virtualisation and technical support.
s5Body: Prototyping, process modelling and technical documentation.
s6Body: Version control, agile practices and visual communication.
journeyIntro: An academic journey between Brazil and Portugal, with practical projects along the way.

communityBody: Turning life at IPB into a community project: a multilingual canteen guide that connects information, accessibility and meal planning.
